children: shares rose 1.10% premarket after Cantor Fitzgerald reiterated its Overweight rating and $122 price target on the stock, implying roughly 89% upside from current levels. Shares trade at $64.57, down about 57% from a 52-week high of $151.

Cantor's bull case rests on Rocket Lab's launch track record across its three vehicle types, Electron, Haste and Neutron, along with a customer base split across commercial and government buyers, domestic and international. The firm called Rocket Lab's dedicated launchpads in New Zealand and the U.S. a material advantage, and views the diversification and infrastructure together as durable moats against competitors.

The firm framed the current price as a good entry point ahead of two catalysts it expects to move the stock, Neutron's first launch and the closing of Rocket Lab's pending acquisition of Iridium Communications. Cantor didn't attach a timeline to either event in the note.

title: Cantor Bets Neutron and Iridium Reprice Rocket Lab Higher
